scientific_question: Did the 256x learned-butterfly c_fc oracle fail because eight experts require conflicting layer-shared frame rotations, or because one butterfly sweep is inadequate even when every expert receives its own frame?

causal_parent.finding: Layer-shared learned frames moved by 0.25-0.36 radians but reached only 0.367 heldout recovery, 0.0115-0.0141 below the fixed-frame spectral control. The parent closes deployment of that shared family but leaves sharing conflict versus topology capacity unidentified.

source.terminal_gauge: Replay the exact parent discovery samples and heldout activations with terminal routing, dense c_fc targets, and exact terminal dense c_proj.

shared_endpoint_gradient_audit.quantity: For each bank, layer, and expert, compute the normalized parent functional objective gradient with respect to cloned shared input and hidden butterfly angles while holding that expert's fitted spectrum/bias fixed.
shared_endpoint_gradient_audit.pairwise_metric: Cosine between flattened per-expert shared-angle gradients.
shared_endpoint_gradient_audit.cancellation_ratio: ||sum_e g_e||^2 / (E * sum_e ||g_e||^2); one means aligned equal gradients, approximately 1/E means orthogonal gradients, and values near zero imply cancellation/conflict.

nondeployable_upper_bound.name: per_expert_one_sweep_butterfly_frames
nondeployable_upper_bound.initialization: Clone the fitted parent shared input/hidden angles independently for each expert; initialize each expert's spectrum and bias from the same parent endpoint.
nondeployable_upper_bound.fit: Replay the exact parent compact-only AdamW protocol for 400 final-step-selected steps on each discovery bank, vectorized across experts, with LR 0.03, weight decay 0.0001, gradient clip 10, and the same normalized output plus 0.25 pre-GELU objective.
nondeployable_upper_bound.why_not_deployable: Per-expert input and hidden frames exceed the 200x target by more than 3.2x. This arm is a causal upper bound only and can never authorize implementation or training.

decision_rule.sharing_conflict_confirmed: All shared-gradient conflict thresholds and all nondeployable upper-bound thresholds pass. Conclude expert sharing is causally binding, but do not implement the 62x oracle; return to a >200x grouped or conditional frame theory before any new candidate.
decision_rule.topology_insufficient: The per-expert upper bound misses any absolute or gain threshold. Close the exact one-sweep butterfly topology itself; do not change sharing, stages, padding, fit LR, or thresholds without a new theoretical family.
decision_rule.ambiguous: If only one side passes, record the mismatch and perform no implementation or training. A new residual analysis is required.
decision_rule.systems: Run an exact-shape five-step preflight. Foreground-poll only if projected total runtime is under five minutes; otherwise attach a terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog.
